page.overview:
What is Druddigon?

Druddigon is a blue dragon with a gold-colored underbelly, and a spiked red head. It has long blue arms with red spikes jutting out from them. It also has two, ragged blue wings on its back. It also has 2 giant feet, with white claws.

Druddigon always basks in the sun in order to regulate its body temperature. If its body temperature falls to cooling point, Druddigon will remain motionless. Its head is as hard as rock. Druddigon is extremely vicious and cunning, waiting inside cavern tunnels dug by Diglett and Dugtrio for prey to pass by. It also takes up residence in empty dens, claiming them as its own turf.

Druddigon first appeared in The Dragon Master's Path! under the ownership of Emmy where it would not obey her until Iris helped Emmy train Druddigon.
